probe.name: CASE_C_single_state_restrict_NEW
probe.sql:
SELECT ts_dedup.timestamp,
       sum(md_per_bldg.bldg_metadata_rows) AS metadata_rows_count,
       count(distinct md_per_bldg.bldg_id) AS model_count,
       sum(md_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS units_count,
       sum(ts_dedup.bs_elec * md_per_bldg.bldg_weight) AS elec_baseline
FROM (
  SELECT ts.bldg_id,
         date_trunc('month', date_add('second', -900, ts.timestamp)) AS timestamp,
         CAST(sum(ts."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption") FILTER (WHERE ts.upgrade=0) AS DOUBLE) / count(distinct ts.state) AS bs_elec
  FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_ts_by_state AS ts
  WHERE ts.upgrade IN (0, 1) AND ts.state='CO' AND (ts.bldg_id, ts.state) IN (
      SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs
      WHERE bs.upgrade IN (1) AND bs.applicability=true AND bs.state IN ('CO')
      GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs.state HAVING count(distinct(bs.upgrade))=1
    )
  GROUP BY ts.bldg_id, date_trunc('month', date_add('second', -900, ts.timestamp))
) AS ts_dedup
JOIN (
  SELECT bs.bldg_id, sum(bs.weight) AS bldg_weight, count(*) AS bldg_metadata_rows
  FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.upgrade=0 AND bs.state='CO' AND (bs.bldg_id, bs.state) IN (
      SELECT bs2.bldg_id, bs2.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_agg_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs2
      WHERE bs2.upgrade IN (1) AND bs2.applicability=true AND bs2.state IN ('CO')
      GROUP BY bs2.bldg_id, bs2.state HAVING count(distinct(bs2.upgrade))=1
    )
  GROUP BY bs.bldg_id
) AS md_per_bldg ON ts_dedup.bldg_id = md_per_bldg.bldg_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
